Profile

About Me

Full-stack developer specializing in cloud-native Java Spring Boot microservices in high-complexity environments. Columbia University graduate with a dual-B.A./B.S. in Computer Science and Human Rights. Strong experience with microservice observability in cloud-native environments.

Prior roles include leading automated integration testing and application monitoring efforts across a suite of containerized microservices, specifically through the design of intuitive, user-friendly Grafana dashboards for use by both service developers and non-technical maintainers.
